title: Normalize artifact into catalog JSON and MySQL upsert flow
action: Convert parsed artifact into existing catalog JSON shapes and upsert records into MySQL with stable IDs and provenance.
implementation: Generate stable `canonical_problem_id` and `official_problem_id`-style IDs for WanJuanWang C++ GESP questions using session, level, question type, question number and WanJuanWang `questionid`.
Produce classification, detail, answer-guidance placeholder and source-version structures aligned with `CatalogService` expectations.
Add a MySQL seed/upsert script that writes `classification_records`, `problem_details`, `problem_answer_guidance` and `source_versions` transactionally.
Keep answer fields empty or `needs_review` when the public page does not expose answers.
verification_notes: Catalog builder runs successfully and writes 1836 normalized records.
MySQL seed script compiles and executes successfully.
Direct MySQL queries confirm 1836 classification records, 1836 detail records, 1836 answer guidance records and 1836 source versions for WanJuanWang data.
